title: Exact output of the zero-prefixing machine
statement: For any two finite binary words $w$ and $x$, the machine defined using $w$ halts with output equal to the concatenation of $|x|$ zero bits and $w$, after exactly $|x|+|w|+2$ steps.
replaced: For every fixed word $w$ and every input $x$, the zero-prefixing emitter for $w$ halts within $|x| + |w| + 2$ steps, and its complete output is the word of $|x|$ zero bits followed by $w$.
